meta.probingQuestion: What do you do when someone pushes back?

games.title: Post and Hook Destabilization Game (Guard Retention)

meta.connection: A partner resisting the pin is pushback made physical. What you do when they fight the pin is usually what you do when people push back in life. Both reward staying calm and adjusting over forcing harder.
meta.takeaway: Tonight you worked from an underhook tie, open guard, and riding position. A partner fighting your pin is pushback made physical, and staying calm beats forcing harder every time. That is usually true with people too. You get to choose your response to pushback instead of reacting on reflex.

slides.title: What do you do when someone pushes back?

body.text: This is using an underhook for a leg.

items: The underhook player wins by attaching to and picking up the overhook player's leg.
The overhook player wins by stopping the underhook player for 30 seconds.

body.text: This is knocking someone off balance, feet only.

items: The bottom player wins by putting the top player's hips on the floor using only posts and hooks.
The top player wins by stopping the bottom player's win for 30 seconds. Then switch.

body.text: This is staying on top, hands and knees.

items: The top player holds as long as he keeps the bottom player broken down.
The bottom player wins by standing up and turning to face the top player.

slides.title: What made it work?
slides.question: Tonight he pushed back standing, passing, and pinning, and you kept your spot every time. What made that work?

options.text: Staying calm instead of forcing harder.
options.feedback: Staying calm under pushback is a choice. Forcing harder is just a reflex.
Forcing harder usually costs more than it wins.

options.text: Giving up your spot to avoid the push.
options.feedback: Giving up your spot is not the same as handling the push.

body.text: Tonight you worked from an underhook tie, open guard, and riding position. A partner fighting your pin is pushback made physical, and staying calm beats forcing harder every time. That is usually true with people too. You get to choose your response to pushback instead of reacting on reflex.
